findings: All five trials have the same first hold LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE, release, then second explicit hold with visible Recording. That sequence does not uniquely identify the failed trial.
Outgoing fixture/body hashes, gain 500, 1000ms padding each side, blocking delivery, zero-source-byte initialization gRPC0, source gRPC0 and host input OFF checks match across all five.

The clean failure has one active unsilenced mono 16k PCM16 VOICE_RECOGNITION input at every sampled point, progressing frame counts and signal-power values reaching -14.4 dB, also reached by all four passes. This is not evidence of a floor-only capture.

The clean failure READY/stream-completion timing overlaps the later two diagnostic passes closely; the earlier two passes are slower. These samples do not isolate a simple cold-first or extra-delay explanation.

All four PASS captures used diagnostic APK 98ed4f5fb6311d64b96381b08e99fb19a5f243c21fd078fd4ea4a774bcdd2d23 with a temporary exporter/hook. The clean failure used different APK 7300f2aefeb8d5f90882655d46435b100a12531e16a7c70df4f81230f4160454 after hook removal. Build/hook and actual captured-buffer differences remain confounded.
measurementLimits: AudioFlinger signal-power history is a sampled route diagnostic, not a saved waveform or proof of complete correct source PCM inside the app. Printed sum(...) summaries are excluded from sample counts/statistics.
The clean failed capture has no saved PCM or final capture metrics here, so its full capture/profile-derived buffer cannot be compared with the four diagnostic PCM captures.

These files do not explicitly record selected runtime decoder engine, model hash/settings, cache state, or model-prepare/decode durations for each call. The same first-hold sequence alone does not prove equivalent decoder warm state.
Cold-boot grouping of the two paired reports is from root run notes; the paired report metadata itself does not identify a boot ID.
Power values are AudioFlinger signal level in dB; no phone battery/CPU power or performance measurement is claimed.
V05 and every physical-device, human speech/accent/audibility and phone-performance gate remain NOT RUN. The 47-case campaign result is outside this scoped comparison.

staticSourceContext.fact: Bare LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE belongs to the Android recognizer/support path and marks the language failed on that per-panel SpeechInput instance. The next new explicit auto hold chooses Whisper if available. It is not automatic in-session fallthrough.

Every start checks Whisper availability, which may initialize the JNI library and inspect model asset length before engine choice. The first Android-failure path does not call Whisper transcribe. Model verification/copy/hash and native decoder context work are reached only after capture.read and the signal gate. This does not establish equal OS/library/cache state.

Current source creates a CPU native decoder context per call; English reminder configuration is beam 3, temperature 0, 2 threads, no_context, fixed local hint and relative signal-boundary profile. JNI deadline is 30 seconds; the separate aggregate transcription timeout is 60 seconds, with 15-second capture. These are static configuration facts, not per-trial measured settings/load durations.

SpeechInput events can carry session/type/engine/elapsed/reason and aggregate recording/transcription timing. The React module owns a separate GENERAL instance; the native reminder owns its private REMINDER_RESPONSE instance and consumes events for UI. These trial files do not expose its full decoder event stream or model-load/cache telemetry.
